text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bring on the happy! Happy birthday,<n>Doto!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh! I never forget the<n>birthdays of people
I've read<n>horoscopes for!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Which is why I've come here today<n>to do a special
birthday reading, just<n>for you!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
W-wow, you'd do that for someone<n>like me? Thank
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll start off with palm<n>reading, then fortune
reading, and<n>then face reading!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're going to do three whole<n>different
readings?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But wait, there's more! Flower<n>reading, astrology,
tasseography—we<n>might as well do them all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-wow! You'd really do all that for<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's why I'm here! Doto,<n>let's fill this
year full with fortune!
